sealedIndex.name: Catchem Sealed Index
sealedIndex.baseline: chain-linked from 100.0; each day's move is the average return of products present on both days
sealedIndex.simple: One number for the whole sealed market. It starts at 100 and moves by the average daily change of the products we track — only products we could price on both days count toward a move, so adding or removing products never shifts it.

valueWeighted.name: Catchem Sealed Index — value weighted
valueWeighted.simple: Same shelf, but the expensive boxes get a bigger say. If this number and the main one disagree, the cheap end and the expensive end of the market are moving differently.
valueWeighted.method: Each product's move is weighted by what it was worth at its baseline, so a $5,000 box counts for more than a $10 pack. The main index gives every product one equal vote.

rawIndex.name: Raw Chase Index
rawIndex.note: same equation as the Sealed Index — confirmed chase singles, each against its own first clean price

gradedIndex.note: same equation, graded shelf — waiting on a licensed daily graded-price feed

model.buyerSide: delivered eBay total + sales tax (est. 7% — set your own in the app)
model.sellerSide: eBay ask minus 13.25% final value fee and $0.40 per order
model.note: Both figures are estimates from published fee schedules. A show price between them beats the online route for buyer and seller alike.
model.formula: buyerCeiling = ask × (1 + taxPct/100) · sellerFloor = ask × (1 − feePct/100) − feeFixed
